items.text: Ravens finalizing trade for Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett after Lamar Jackson (thumb) requires surgery and heads to IR (likely season-ending) and Tyler Huntley (turf toe) also out for season. Deal expected complete this weekend; Joe Fagnano starts TNF vs JAX.
items.why: Thumb surgery on first snap return from ankle; Huntley also SE toe.
items.implication: Ravens QB situation collapsed; Brissett stabilizes post-Week 9. Avoid BAL pass-catchers short-term; Henry/Flowers script risk.
items.opportunity: Fagnano streaming/DFS dart; reverse prior Huntley beneficiaries.

items.text: A.J. Brown misses another game due to lingering knee issue per ETR Week 9 team-by-team flags with Levitan/Silva.
items.why: Lingering knee; flagged in ETR preview.
items.implication: NE WR depth elevated; monitor practice but expect absence.

items.text: Levitan/Silva on SEA backfield with Charbonnet and Jadarian Price returns: 'like Charbonnet/Walker expect with worse versions of the players.'
items.why: Both returning; committee expected similar to prior but diluted talent.
items.implication: Neither clear lead; split snaps/carries reduces upside.
items.opportunity: Handcuff both; monitor early snaps for hierarchy.

items.text: 49ers: Nick Bosa returns to practice; RB Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) and WR Mike Evans DNP Wednesday. Shanahan has no expectation for Brandon Aiyuk.
items.why: CMC hamstring management typical early-week; Evans Achilles tendinitis lingering.
items.implication: CMC likely plays but monitor; Evans higher risk OUT. Aiyuk irrelevant.
items.opportunity: SF RB committee/other WRs if either sits.

items.text: Wheels completely fall off for IND, Jonathan Taylor saga continues in Week 9 flags.
items.why: Ongoing IND dysfunction/role uncertainty flagged by Levitan/Silva.
items.implication: JT less reliable; monitor IND backfield closely.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs elevated; possible committee or reduced efficiency.

items.text: Zach Charbonnet or Jadarian Price ROS? Give me CHARB!
items.why: Berry prefers Charbonnet for rest-of-season over Price in returning committee.
items.implication: Charbonnet higher ROS rank/priority in SEA backfield.
items.opportunity: Prefer Charbonnet in trades/waivers if available; Price handcuff.

items.text: Ryan Flournoy has scored double-digit fantasy points in FOUR straight games. Why is he still on waivers? Targeting him among WRs for Week 9.
items.why: 4 straight double-digit games; routes competitive with Pickens/Lamb.
items.implication: Add in deeper leagues; DAL WR committee beneficiary.
items.opportunity: High-upside waiver add with proven recent production/usage.

items.text: Waiver wire: Mike Washington Jr. handed LV workhorse RB role Wk8 (25-2 carries edge over Ashton Jeanty). Stickiness TBD but workload noteworthy.
items.why: 25-2 carry edge for Washington over Jeanty.
items.implication: Jeanty demoted short-term; Washington waiver/priority add.

items.text: Cowboys WR routes on 38 Dak dropbacks (even with Ferguson early exit): CeeDee Lamb 29, Ryan Flournoy 26, George Pickens 25, Mingo 7. Plenty of 2-TE sets.
items.why: Route shares nearly even among top 3 WRs; 2-TE heavy.
items.implication: Pickens/Flournoy viable alongside Lamb; no clear alpha beyond Lamb.
items.opportunity: Flournoy waiver/stream; Pickens target share stable but not dominant.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (high ankle sprain) placed on IR, out 4-5 weeks.
items.why: Re-aggravated right high-ankle sprain vs DAL.
items.implication: ARI backfield opens; stash if IR spot, but multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: Tyler Allgeier (or others) lead role expansion, goal-line.

items.text: Rams open IR window for TE Terrance Ferguson who practices today. Last full game (Wk2, Nacua out): 42% slot/wide, 70% routes, 29% target share with Adams playing.
items.why: Prior high route/target share when Nacua absent.
items.implication: Potential TE upside if activated; LAR pass game redistribution risk/reward.
items.opportunity: Monitor activation; deep TE streamer if volume returns.

items.text: Keeping it OPEN on Ladd McConkey this week as a WR3. Let’s not get carried away.
items.why: Berry open as WR3 floor play.

items.text: Jerry Jones said George Pickens needs the ball more. Does that change anything for fantasy? Not really.
items.why: Coach/owner comments don't alter route/target reality.
items.implication: Pickens remains solid but committee-limited WR2/3.

items.text: Trevor Lawrence only QB9 in FPPG but would be far higher if Jags not playing so well. Passing by quarter heavy early (1st/2nd dominant attempts/yards/TDs); not 'step on throat' philosophy.
items.why: Quarter-by-quarter volume shows front-loaded passing when games competitive.
items.implication: Positive game scripts suppress late volume; still solid QB1 upside in shootouts.
items.opportunity: JAX pass-catchers (esp early) elevated in positive scripts.
